title: Amendment 3: known-clean client profiles (bsc_5) and their development validation
written: 2026-10-05, after the lock-in diagnosis (addendum A8) and before any bsc_5 run
change: Cohort channel counts only the excess of K above max(leave-one-out peer median, the client's own known-clean profile). Profile = 0.90 quantile, per (fold, probe, target), of that client's K over all rounds of the known-clean calibration trajectories (seeds 42, 44, 45). Threshold-fitting rows use cross-fitted profiles (built without their own seed); leave-one-seed-out folds nest this; deployment uses profiles from all calibration seeds. --client-profile off reproduces bsc_4. No other change.
added_assumption: Stable client identities with known-clean history for every client. Evasion route: an attacker whose trigger lies inside its own clean profile.

fixed_before_running.attack: poison 0.5, malicious ratio 0.25, trigger columns 5-8 value 5
fixed_before_running.criteria: unchanged from AMENDMENT_live_development_gate.json (detection >= 70%, poisoned retention before revocation <= 20%, first alert by the 3rd poisoned participation, unpoisoned alert FPR <= 5%, no stop)

overfitting_guard: Seed 46 has informed three decisions. A NEW development seed, 43, is added with its own shadow capture. The live development gate is run on seeds 43 AND 46; both must pass. Seed 43 is chosen because it has not been used under the current protocol.
procedure: 1. Refit calibration H from the same controls/capture/cached measurements (no training, no inference).
2. Shadow (FedAvg) attacked capture on seed 43 with the selected attack, using calibration H.
3. Calibration I with controls + shadow captures 43 and 46 (probe inference for the new capture only).
4. Live development gate, filter mode, seeds 43 and 46, calibration I.
decision: Phase 2b (fresh seeds 53-57, matched FedAvg) is pre-registered and run only if the gate passes on both seeds. Otherwise the result is recorded; criteria, attack and profile quantile are not changed to obtain a pass.
also_reported: Live clean filter runs are not part of this gate; clean false-alarm behaviour is covered by the leave-one-seed-out check and by Phase 2b's paired clean runs.
